# Recognition metrics — local vision service (G3.1)

<!-- Generated by `npm run vision:eval` (vision-service/scripts/evaluate.py). Do not edit by hand. -->

Same targets as the browser recognizer (`recognition-metrics.md`): EMPTY precision ≥ 98 %, WHITE/BLACK recall ≥ 95 %, zero confident errors. UNKNOWN is an abstention: it lowers recall, never precision. The service is checked for parity with the browser recognizer square by square (`vision-service/tests/test_parity.py`), so on lossless frames these numbers are the browser's.

## Real samples — JPEG transport

The app sends frames to the service as JPEG (quality 0.9 by default, encoded in the remote worker). Here each PNG frame is re-encoded with OpenCV's libjpeg at the given quality before recognition (Chromium's encoder is also libjpeg-turbo; quality scales match approximately).

## Synthetic regression boards (not evidence)

Rendered boards of the browser suites (metrics scenarios and the EMPTY suite with shadows, glare, a fingertip, a hand, a phone), exported by `npm run vision:contract`. They guard known failure modes, kings included; they do not measure field accuracy. Adversarial EMPTY scenarios are expected to produce UNKNOWN, never a piece.

- Images: 31 · playable squares: 992

## Processing time (service, in process)

Real 1280 × 720 frames as JPEG 90, 10 runs per sample (70 frames), this machine. HTTP transport is measured separately (`docs/testing/service-performance.md`).

| Stage                           |  Median |     p90 |
| ------------------------------- | ------: | ------: |
| JPEG decode                     |  4.5 ms |  5.0 ms |
| Warp                            |  0.6 ms |  0.7 ms |
| Quality + denoise + recognition | 37.8 ms | 48.7 ms |
| Total                           | 42.9 ms | 53.7 ms |

Automatic corner adjustment: median 4489 ms over 7 samples.
